message.resonantinduction.entangler.mark: Marked Tesla tower at [%s, %s, %s]. Use on another tower to link.
message.resonantinduction.entangler.link: Linked with the tower at [%s, %s, %s] in %s
message.resonantinduction.entangler.fail: Could not link: the marked device is gone, of another kind, or out of reach
tooltip.resonantinduction.entangler.empt: Use on a Tesla tower or levitator to mark it, then on another to link them
jei.resonantinduction.tesla: Stack Tesla Coils into a tower; each coil above the first adds 4 blocks of range (up to 50). Power the bottom coil from any side but the top: the tower beams energy to other towers of two or more coils within range, which push it into machines next to their bottom coil. Dye a tower to give it a frequency; light blue (the default) talks to every colour. Empty hand: toggle receiving. Redstone dust: toggle zapping mobs in the arcs. A redstone signal stops a tower sending. Sneak-use with an empty hand shows the tower's status.
jei.resonantinduction.quantum_entangler: Use on one Tesla tower, then another, to link them: linked towers send only to each other, even across dimensions (the far end's chunk must be loaded). Also links a pushing and a pulling Electromagnetic Levitator. Sneak-use a device to unlink it.
message.resonantinduction.levitator.pull: Levitator: pulling items into the inventory
message.resonantinduction.levitator.push: Levitator: pushing items out along the beam
jei.resonantinduction.levitator: Place on the side of an inventory. In pull mode (default) it puts items that reach it into the inventory. Sneak-use with an empty hand to switch to push mode: it takes items out one at a time and carries them along its beam to a levitator facing it, up to 40 blocks away. Link a pushing and a pulling levitator with a Quantum Entangler to carry items around corners (up to 200 blocks). Dye changes the beam colour; a redstone signal turns it off.
tooltip.resonantinduction.glyph: Fill all eight corners of a block with glyphs to make a Quantum Gate
jei.resonantinduction.glyph_nought: Each glyph fills one corner of a block; fill all eight corners to make a Quantum Gate. The order of the glyphs sets its frequency. Gates on the same frequency, in any dimension, teleport mobs and items that land on them to another gate on that frequency. Players go by sneaking on a gate or sneak-using it with an empty hand. They also share one item slot and a one-bucket fluid tank that hoppers and pipes can use from every side.

jei.resonantinduction.charger: Place on any face of a block and put a chargeable item on it (right-click with the item; empty hand takes it back). Power fed into the charger goes straight into the item. Hoppers and pipes can load it too.
jei.resonantinduction.mining_laser: Hold use to fire. Sneak-use switches mode. Remove: holding the beam on a block for 15 ticks cuts it out (wood, plants and wool catch fire, TNT is lit). Smelt: sand to glass, cobblestone to stone, ice to water, obsidian to lava; flammable blocks burn. Damage: only hurts. The beam sets mobs on fire. Uses FE: charge it in a Charger.
jei.resonantinduction.copper_wire: Carries FE between machines. Place it flat on a face, or sneak to place it through the middle of a block. Wires only join wires of the same metal. Use wool to insulate (bare live wires shock), dye to recolour the insulation (insulated wires only join the same colour or white), shears to strip it, and a lever to make a switch wire that only conducts while powered by redstone.

tooltip.resonantinduction.wire.help: Sneak to place through a block; wool insulates, a lever makes a switch
jei.resonantinduction.battery: Stores FE. Batteries placed against each other merge into one bank and share their energy. Every face starts as an input; use a wrench (or sneak-use with an empty hand) on a face to switch it between input, output and off. Output faces push energy into whatever is next to them. Keeps its charge when broken, and can be charged in a Charger. Tier 2 is made from eight tier 1 batteries, tier 3 from eight tier 2.
jei.resonantinduction.solar_panel: Makes 50 FE a tick under open sky in daytime, when it is not raining. Pushes power out of every side.
jei.resonantinduction.thermopile: Makes power from hot and cold blocks touching it: water (1) or ice and snow (2) on the cold side, fire (1) or lava (2) on the hot side. Output is 15 FE a tick times (3 - the difference), when it has both. After two minutes of use the sources reach equilibrium: water boils away, ice melts, fire dies and lava cools to stone.
